name: pi-vibeguard
notes: Forked from aizigao/pi-vibeguard (npm @aizigao/pi-vibeguard v0.1.2). The Mapping View contract lives in openspec (spec vibeguard-mapping-view).

knownDebt.reason: Diff-alignment artifact on a repeated closing brace: the raw diff pairs `-}` with `+}` while `git diff -w` renders `}` as unchanged context; the file is otherwise at upstream bytes.

reapplyOnSync: keep the packaging divergence: npm name @xzzpig/pi-vibeguard, the repository field repointed to xzzpig/pi-extensions, and the @earendil-works/pi-tui peerDependency (range aligned with pi-tool-display) plus the vitest devDep
keep the fork-only modules mapping-view.ts, category-picker.ts and suspension-filter.ts, with index.ts holding the imports, construction sites, the SuspensionState class and the /vibeguard:* commands

keep the tsconfig include widening (tests, allowImportingTsExtensions) with test-engine.ts excluded from typecheck, and keep eslint ignoring test-engine.ts since typed linting requires tsconfig membership
keep the README fork notice and the CHANGELOG 0.1.0 fork entry
doNotReintroduce: do not thread the suspension skip-params through redactText/redactDeep/redactMessageContent: those three engine functions stay byte-identical to upstream, and the call-site PatternSet filter (suspension-filter.ts) replaces that threading
